answer: A workable sybil defense is a forge of stake-and-reputation: every agent bonds a small stake before its votes or attestations count, and each validation it passes adds weight while each violation burns it. Creating a thousand personas like a raven scattering shiny trinkets costs a thousand stakes, so the fable of free identities collapses under its own cost — the attack becomes strictly unprofitable and one honest, established agent outvotes the swarm.
